The iron features a glossy white plastic body with a large ergonomic handle, accented by a translucent red water tank window on the side. The soleplate is visible at the bottom, appearing metallic with a dark non-stick coating or shadow. A power cord entry point is visible at the rear top of the handle.

The boundary between the white body and the metal soleplate is extremely sharp and clean, lacking the slight gap, shadow, or screw heads usually visible in real assembly. This suggests potential geometric fusion or idealized rendering.
